prompt:
GAME ZONE TOOL ICON. One flat round badge seen straight on, centred, as an icon on a command button in a top-down strategy game.

Image 1 is our approved icon from the same set: keep its layout exactly, a round badge with a thick dark rim, a symbol in the middle, and a small green circle holding a white plus sign overlapping the rim at the lower right. Match its outline weight, shading and finish. Do not copy its radiation symbol or its yellow and magenta colours. Image 2 is the same set's other icon: it shows that only the small corner badge differs between the two.

Create an ORIGINAL icon meaning "mark this ground as a toxic hazard area": the same round badge, its face a muted sickly yellow-green, bearing in the middle the chemical hazard symbol for a toxic substance: a bold near-black skull, front on, above two crossed bones. At the lower right, overlapping the rim, the same small bright green circle holding a bold white plus sign.

Style: an icon for the game RimWorld: a very thick near-black outline around every shape, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones, a muted palette with the green plus badge as the brightest colour, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

Draw ONLY the icon, alone on a plain pure white background, the badge filling about four fifths of the canvas. Square canvas. No text, letters, numbers, people or hands. The skull is a plain hazard symbol, not gory or menacing.
